title: Hybrid VT w=2000: MaxDD 改善但 Sharpe 降低
description: Hybrid VT w=2000 vs w=504: Sharpe 0.635 vs 0.745 (-0.11), MaxDD -25.6% vs -29.5% (+4pp). Larger window → higher persistence → slower weight recovery → less bull market capture. Trade-off consistent with QLIKE finding. For MaxDD-sensitive investors w=2000 better, for Sharpe-sensitive w=504 better.
